properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MUJJE,nga mwetereereka
Mwenna-eriKatonda,
Okwagala kwe kujjuze
-Emyoyo gyammwe.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Wulira:ggwe-alindirira
-Omugole wo leero,
Mu kwagalana-okutaggwaawo
Mugattibwe.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Naawe akkiriza wano
Okumufumbirwa,
Laba Kitaffe awulira
-Obweyamo bwo!

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Mujje nga mwetereereka;
Mukama waffe-ajja,
Okubasembeza gy'ali,
-Abagole be

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Bwe mutyo mwetereereke
Agabire bonna
Omwaoyo-Omutukuvu
Abasaba.
